WITH fan_data AS (
    SELECT 
        f.user_registry,
        f.nick_label,
        COALESCE(AVG(CAST(i.gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd' AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(i.sess_dur_min, 0)), 0) AS avg_fmi,
        COALESCE(
            (CAST(e.evt_participation->>'On_Evt_Att' AS NUMERIC)) * 1 +
            (CAST(e.evt_participation->>'Off_Evt_Att' AS NUMERIC)) * 1.5 +
            (CAST(e.evt_participation->>'Meet_Att' AS NUMERIC)) * 2,
            0
        ) AS eps,
        CAST(f.demo_profile->>'Age_Count' AS INTEGER) AS age,
        f.demo_profile->>'Occu_Path' AS occu_path
    FROM fans f
    JOIN membershipandspending m ON f.user_registry = m.member_fan_pivot
    JOIN eventsandclub e ON m.member_reg = e.events_member_pivot
    LEFT JOIN interactions i ON i.interact_fan_pivot = f.user_registry
    GROUP BY f.user_registry, f.nick_label, f.demo_profile, e.evt_participation
),
superfans AS (
    SELECT user_registry, nick_label, avg_fmi, eps, age, occu_path
    FROM fan_data
    WHERE avg_fmi > 20 AND eps > 25
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_superfans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (age >= 30 OR age IS NULL) AND LOWER(occu_path::text) = 'professional' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pro_superfans,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN (age >= 30 OR age IS NULL) AND LOWER(occu_path::text) = 'professional' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS pct_pro_superfans
FROM superfans;
